selection_rationale: Best match to the programme remit (operational reliability of LLM-generated NetOps), high venue relevance and falsifiability, feasible within resource bounds, and addresses a high-priority sim-to-real/generalization gap that follows directly from the evidence synthesis.
unresolved_uncertainties: Publicly synthesized production-like topologies may not capture proprietary vendor idiosyncrasies (external validity).
Deterministic verifiers (e.g., Batfish) may produce false positives/negatives for vendor-specific behaviors—extent and direction uncertain.
Hosted-model API rate limits, latency, or cost may constrain planned throughput and interact with preregistered retry policy.
Residual risk of inadvertently including sensitive or copyrighted configuration patterns when synthesizing production-like configs.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify exact public sources and the synthesis procedure for production-like topologies, including provenance metadata and filtering criteria.
Define verifier modelling assumptions per vendor and enumerated verifier checks; preregister a manual-adjudication protocol and sample for false-positive/negative analysis.
Preregister sample-size and power calculations, exact retry policy, seed management, allowed prompt variants, and stopping rules for model-call budget.
Add an explicit data-sensitivity review and PII/copyright filtering pipeline with release criteria for any synthesized or derived artifacts.
